results.title: Postman becomes 'first Englishman to hold a World Cup winner's medal in 60 years' thanks to Marc Cucurella
results.description: Marc Cucurella won praise after letting his local postman hold and wear Spain’s 2026 FIFA World Cup winner’s medal during a mail delivery at his Horsham home. The heartwarming gesture quickly went viral, with fans applauding the defender’s humility. Cucurella has since joined Real Madrid following Spain’s World Cup triumph, beginning a new chapter in his career.
